card.name: Commas in pseudotumor cerebri symptom lists
card.fires_on: The comma (rarely 'and') right after 'headache' or a neighbouring symptom in lists of pseudotumor cerebri / intracranial hypertension signs. It appears in warnings about tetracyclines and GnRH agonists.

modes.label: Comma after headache
modes.description: Comma following 'headache' at the start of a symptom list for intracranial hypertension.
modes.example: Clinical manifestations of IH include headache<<,>> blurred vision, diplopia, and

modes.label: Comma after papilledema
modes.description: Comma or 'and' later in the same symptom list, after papilledema or nausea.
modes.example: Early signs and symptoms of pseudotumor cerebri include papilledema, headache, nausea<< and>> vomiting, and visual disturbances.

card.plain: It marks the separator inside a list of warning symptoms for raised pressure in the skull, such as headache, papilledema and blurred vision.
